e491dfa958fb8ebf437a1ce367e98d624a9371a7.summary: DataBreaches reports that the AlphV group added MeridianLink, a provider of a loan origination system and digital lending platform for financial institutions, to its leak site. According to AlphV, the November 7 attack involved data exfiltration but no encryption. AlphV also filed a complaint with the SEC alleging MeridianLink failed to file a disclosure under Item 1.05 of Form 8-K within four business days. MeridianLink said it identified a cybersecurity incident on Nov 10, contained it, and found no evidence of unauthorized access to production platforms. Its investigation is ongoing. The…

e4e99526c558b60b7b3a9600ce869fb4a29e54dc.summary: In October 2019 hackers breached Volusion, a provider of cloud-hosted online stores, and altered a file on its Google Cloud infrastructure so that card details entered in shoppers' forms were captured. The report says more than 6,500 stores were impacted and the number could be higher. It describes the incident as a Magecart-style web card skimming supply-chain attack. Earlier in 2019, seven service providers were breached through misconfigured cloud-hosting accounts. Volusion did not respond to the reporter or security researchers.

e4f1843a841f5d66f14a2f70ab97f606bece5888.summary: Card data stolen in the Volusion web skimmer breach, discovered in October 2019, was uploaded to a dark web hacking forum in November 2019 and has been for sale since. The breach started on September 7 and hit 6,589 stores, not the 20,000 first reported. Gemini Advisory estimates the attackers made nearly $1.6 million and suspects up to almost 20 million cards were taken, though it had tracked 239,000 card records. Trend Micro attributed the hack to FIN6, which is also believed to be behind other Magecart web-skimming incidents.
